## Highlights
### New
- Choose how the address field, pins, extensions, selected tab and other glass surfaces read in Appearance: Automatic follows each Space, dark over dark Spaces and light over very light ones, or keep them Light, Dark, or as your Mac's appearance (System).
### Fixed
- The Start Page title on the Mac reads in its Space's light or dark look, so it no longer draws black over a dark Space. - In a narrow sidebar, Copy URL appears in the address field while the pointer is over it, so you can still copy the address with a click.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
